change: Pin the complex lane to k3-256k low effort with path-whitelisted native Read/Write/Edit, strict empty MCP configuration, one same-session k3 medium repair, trace routing metrics, and aggregated dependency/typecheck/source-audit diagnostics.

expo-sharing, expo-document-picker, expo-clipboard, expo-haptics, expo-linear-gradient, expo-status-bar, AsyncStorage, and react-native-svg use exact catalog versions.
Typecheck, source audit, Harmony Go export, artifact binding, exact desktop install/open, and error-overlay detection pass.
gaps: Streak and missed-day scans can count dates before goal.createdAt.

Seed has only 13 entries and does not visibly exercise both rest and rollover states; the 20-entry banner is initially unreachable and its CTA only navigates to My instead of exporting directly.
Desktop launch screenshot shows oversized vertically stretched navigation cells and near-white hero rendering with low-contrast white text.
Core mutation/restart persistence was intentionally not executed in this loop, so runtime persistence remains unproven for this artifact.
